annotations.title: SPF record check: full include tree, DNS lookup count, problems

description: SPF record check: full include tree, DNS lookup count, problems. Fetches the SPF record, expands include: and redirect= recursively, counts DNS-querying mechanisms against the RFC 7208 limit of 10, lists ip4/ip6 ranges and flags problems (multiple records, +all, ?all, missing includes, ptr, loops, void lookups). Price: $0.008 USDC per call via x402 (eip155:8453).
